scope: Bounded C4 return observation only; no product, verifier, workflow, timeout increase or central-ref change.

paths: ConnectFourGameActivity.returnToApp records caller return, sets Activity result, finishes and schedules native-process exit; it does not delete the private C4 session.

MainActivity.onActivityResult.completeWhenStopped normally waits for the native PID to stop, with its existing 100x100ms fallback, commits caller-owned return and sends the launch MethodChannel result.
launchLumo3D awaits that launch result and validates destination/profile; LumoConnectFourGame._openNative then awaits session.close in finally.

ConnectFourTableSession.close stops its timer and calls the separate Host channel; ConnectFourBridge.close synchronously deletes state/request/lifecycle and temporary files plus the token directory under the existing lock.

dispose launches close unawaited; session.close swallows transport exceptions. Source ordering establishes a possible early-observation window, not proof that a particular session eventually disappeared.

observations: fresh private C4 parent-directory find command

observer.per_command_timeout: Remaining shared return budget capped by unchanged global deadline.
observer.retained_originals: Every command retains distinct existing exclusive stdout/stderr/JSON journals. closed_mailbox points to the accepted original empty find stdout; no copied or rewritten command evidence.
observer.subsequent_checks: Unchanged persisted round/preferences, actual Flutter frame/UI, games navigation, reopen with new token/PID, second return and full offline replay.

independent_review.limits: Real eventual cleanup remains unproved until a new device observation. Existing MainActivity 10-second fallback is not an unconditional native-exit guarantee.
